action.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cfg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.kiro/settings/mcp.json','utf8'));const servers=Object.keys(cfg.mcpServers);console.log('=== MCP Server Snapshot ===');console.log('Servers:',servers.join(', '));console.log('Total servers:',servers.length);console.log('Expected tools: ~15 (5 per server)');servers.forEach(s=>{console.log('- '+s+': '+cfg.mcpServers[s].command+' '+cfg.mcpServers[s].args.join(' '));});"
